src/Cluckwork.Api/AuthPolicies.cs.name: Role permissions
src/Cluckwork.Api/AuthPolicies.cs.description: Defines which jobs (Owner, Manager, Worker, Sales and others) may use each part of the app.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/AmbientPrin.name: Ignore stray sign-in
src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/AmbientPrin.description: Makes sign-in addresses disregard any login token a caller happens to send, so the answer never depends on it.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/CredentialE.name: Revoked sign-in check
src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/CredentialE.description: Rejects sign-in tokens that were cancelled, for example after a password change, while still allowing logout.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/FlockScopeR.name: Flock access check
src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/FlockScopeR.description: Works out which flocks the caller may see from their assignments, so workers only see their own.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/ForbiddenPr.name: Access denied message
src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/ForbiddenPr.description: Replies to a blocked request with a clear message naming the missing role instead of an empty refusal.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/Idempotency.name: Repeat-request protection
src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/Idempotency.description: Makes sure a save that is sent twice, such as after a flaky connection, is only applied once.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/Idempotency.name: Repeat-protection settings
src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/Idempotency.description: Holds the time limits for the repeat-request protection.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/IdempotentU.name: Once-only save engine
src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/IdempotentU.description: Records in the database which request is running or done, so a repeated request gets the original answer.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/LogoutPath..name: Logout address check
src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/LogoutPath..description: Recognizes the logout address so the other checks let it through.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/MustChangeP.name: Forced password change
src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/MustChangeP.description: Blocks everything except changing the password until a new account sets its own first-run password.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/OwnerTwoFac.name: Owner two-step requirement
src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/OwnerTwoFac.description: Requires Owners to use two-step verification once their grace period runs out.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/TenantResol.name: Farm identification
src/Cluckwork.Api/Middleware/TenantResol.description: Reads which farm the signed-in person belongs to before any request runs, keeping each farm's data separate.

src/Cluckwork.Api/RateLimiting/RateLimit.name: Request limit settings
src/Cluckwork.Api/RateLimiting/RateLimit.description: Holds how many requests are allowed per time window and how many may run at once.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Security/SecurityHeade.name: Browser security headers
src/Cluckwork.Api/Security/SecurityHeade.description: Adds the standard safety instructions to every page response, such as which sources the browser may load from.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Validation/ValidationR.name: Input error reply
src/Cluckwork.Api/Validation/ValidationR.description: Shapes the reply for bad input, with a readable message and a code for each problem.
